# forgebase_org (Resource)

An organization: the owner of projects, teams, members and roles. The credential that creates it becomes its owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forgebase_org" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
  name = "Acme Inc."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (1-100 characters).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name: 1-64 of `a-z`, `0-9`, `-`, `_`. Cannot change.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned organization id.
- `realm_id` (String) Realm the organization belongs to.


## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# By organization id.
terraform import forgebase_org.acme org_abc123
```
